title: What to pay for a Business ➡️ M.A.F.I.A.
description:
How much should you really pay for a business? In this video, we break down how to value a business properly so you don't overpay—or miss out on a great deal. From understanding cash flow and EBITDA to factoring in industry trends and deal structures, we’ll show you the key numbers and frameworks you need to make a smart offer. Whether you’re buying your first business or your fifth, getting the valuation right is critical to your success.

We’ll also cover common mistakes buyers make when pricing a business, like chasing revenue instead of profit or ignoring hidden risks. Plus, you’ll learn how seller expectations, financing terms, and market conditions all impact what a business is really worth. If you want to feel confident making an offer—and not get burned—this video is for you.
